purpose: Explanatory historical replay, not a preregistered or out-of-sample investment experiment
intervalPolicy: 4320 is the deployed parameter; 1008 and 144 are hypothetical stress comparisons, not proposed changes
startPolicy: Use the first fixture height; non-overlapping chronological periods; no offset selection or resampling
endPolicy: Exclude the last CONFIRMATIONS headers from finalized observations; retain the final incomplete position without assigning it a market price
collateral: WETH units only; no USD conversion or collateral yield
entryPricePolicy: Hypothetical N/2 throughout, including after confirmation delay; not an executable or information-conditioned quote
fixedCostPolicy: Stress case prepays 0.0003 WETH per entered cycle for combined operation costs; assumed, not measured or a bound
entryChargePolicy: 10 bps is a hypothetical all-in acquisition surcharge; secondary transfers have no WujiVault mint fee. Do not add an invented 5 bps mint fee
statistics: incomplete position quantities and idle cash with null liquidation NAV
